grant.name: A flower from {target}
grant.lore: Picked at {target}, for the chapel of {settlement}

title: A pilgrimage
The road to {target}
summary: The priest of {settlement} asks a pilgrim to walk to {target}, {distance} to the {direction}, and bring back a flower for the chapel.
offer: I am too old for the road now. Walk to {target} for me — {distance}, {direction} — and bring back a flower from beside it. The chapel has kept one every year since it was built.
complete: The chapel keeps its custom another year. Go with my blessing.
